```{r import metrics}
library(data.table)

all_files <- list.files(
  ".",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

roc_files <- all_files[
  basename(all_files) %in% c("snp_roc.tsv.gz", "non_snp_roc.tsv.gz")
]

if (length(roc_files) == 0) {
  stop("No snp_roc.tsv.gz or non_snp_roc.tsv.gz files found.")
}

roc <- rbindlist(
  lapply(roc_files, function(file) {
    df <- fread(file)

    vcfeval_dir <- basename(dirname(file))

    df$Difficulty <- basename(dirname(dirname(dirname(file))))
    df$Method <- basename(dirname(dirname(file)))
    df$sample <- sub("^.*\\.(CC[0-9]+)\\..*$", "\\1", vcfeval_dir)
    df$Type <- ifelse(basename(file) == "snp_roc.tsv.gz", "SNV", "Indel")

    df
  }),
  fill = TRUE
)

colnames(roc)[1] <- "threshold"

nrow(roc)
table(roc$Difficulty, roc$Method, roc$Type)
length(unique(roc$sample))
```


```{r plot roc, fig.width=12, fig.height=12}
ggplot(
  roc,
  aes(
    x = false_positives,
    y = true_positives_call,
    color = Method,
    group = interaction(Difficulty, sample, Method, Type)
  )
) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.4) +
  facet_grid(Difficulty ~ Type, scales = "free") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("linear" = "blue", "surjected" = "red")) +
  labs(
    x = "False positives",
    y = "True positives (calls)",
    title = "ROC curves for linear vs surjected methods"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "gray"
  )
```

```{r plot f-measure, fig.width=4*3, fig.height=4}
ggplot(
  roc,
  aes(
    x = threshold,
    y = f_measure,
    color = Method,
    linetype = Type,
    group = interaction(Difficulty, sample, Method, Type)
  )
) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.1, linewidth = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~Difficulty) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("linear" = "blue", "surjected" = "red")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("SNV" = "solid", "Indel" = "dashed")) +
  labs(
    x = "Threshold",
    y = "F-measure",
    title = NULL
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1, 100), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 20, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray") +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 20,
    y = 0.5,
    label = "Threshold = 20",
    angle = 90,
    vjust = -0.5,
    hjust = 1.5,
    size = 3,
    color = "gray"
  )
```

```{r plot counts, fig.width=4, fig.height=3}
library(scales)

roc_plot_counts <- melt(
  subset(roc, threshold == 20),
  id.vars = c("threshold", "Difficulty", "sample", "Type", "Method"),
  measure.vars = c("false_positives", "false_negatives"),
  variable.name = "Count_Type",
  value.name = "Count"
)

roc_plot_counts[, Count_Type := factor(
  Count_Type,
  levels = c("false_positives", "false_negatives"),
  labels = c("False positives", "False negatives")
)]

roc_plot_counts_sum <- roc_plot_counts[
  ,
  .(Count = sum(Count, na.rm = TRUE)),
  by = .(Difficulty, Type, Method, Count_Type)
]

ggplot(
  roc_plot_counts_sum,
  aes(x = Method, y = Count/1e6, fill = Type)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  facet_grid(Difficulty ~ Count_Type, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Count (millions)",
    fill = "Variant type"
  ) +
  theme_cowplot() +
  facet_wrap(~ Count_Type) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("SNV" = "steelblue", "Indel" = "salmon")) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") -> placeholder_plot

placeholder_plot

ggsave(
  "placeholder_plot.svg",
  plot = placeholder_plot,
  width = 4,
  height = 3,
  units = "in"
)
```

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(scales)

setDT(roc_plot_counts)

roc_plot_counts[, Count_Type_short := factor(
  Count_Type,
  levels = c("False positives", "False negatives"),
  labels = c("FP", "FN")
)]

normality_results <- roc_plot_counts[
  ,
  {
    x <- Count[!is.na(Count)]

    if (length(x) >= 3 && length(x) <= 5000 && length(unique(x)) > 1) {
      shapiro_out <- shapiro.test(x)

      .(
        n = .N,
        n_non_missing = length(x),
        mean_count = mean(x),
        sd_count = sd(x),
        shapiro_W = as.numeric(shapiro_out$statistic),
        shapiro_p = shapiro_out$p.value
      )
    } else {
      .(
        n = .N,
        n_non_missing = length(x),
        mean_count = mean(x),
        sd_count = sd(x),
        shapiro_W = NA_real_,
        shapiro_p = NA_real_
      )
    }
  },
  by = .(Type, Difficulty, Count_Type, Method)
]

normality_results[, shapiro_failed := !is.na(shapiro_p) & shapiro_p < 0.05]

normality_results_display <- normality_results[
  order(Type, Difficulty, Count_Type, Method),
  .(
    Type,
    Difficulty,
    Count_Type,
    Method,
    n,
    n_non_missing,
    mean_millions = mean_count / 1e6,
    sd_millions = sd_count / 1e6,
    shapiro_W,
    shapiro_p,
    shapiro_failed
  )
]

normality_results_display

roc_plot_counts_with_outlier_stats <- merge(
  roc_plot_counts,
  normality_results[
    ,
    .(
      Type,
      Difficulty,
      Count_Type,
      Method,
      group_mean = mean_count,
      group_sd = sd_count,
      shapiro_W,
      shapiro_p,
      shapiro_failed
    )
  ],
  by = c("Type", "Difficulty", "Count_Type", "Method"),
  all.x = TRUE
)

roc_plot_counts_with_outlier_stats[
  ,
  z_score := ifelse(
    is.na(group_sd) | group_sd == 0,
    NA_real_,
    (Count - group_mean) / group_sd
  )
]

roc_plot_counts_with_outlier_stats[
  ,
  exclude_outlier := !is.na(z_score) &
    abs(z_score) > 2 &
    shapiro_failed == TRUE
]

excluded_points <- roc_plot_counts_with_outlier_stats[
  exclude_outlier == TRUE,
  .(
    sample,
    Type,
    Difficulty,
    Count_Type,
    Method,
    Count,
    Count_millions = Count / 1e6,
    z_score,
    shapiro_W,
    shapiro_p
  )
][
  order(Type, Difficulty, Count_Type, Method, sample)
]

excluded_points

outlier_filter_summary <- roc_plot_counts_with_outlier_stats[
  ,
  .(
    n_total = .N,
    n_excluded = sum(exclude_outlier, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_remaining = sum(!exclude_outlier, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  by = .(Type, Difficulty, Count_Type, Method)
][
  order(Type, Difficulty, Count_Type, Method)
]

outlier_filter_summary

roc_plot_counts_filtered <- roc_plot_counts_with_outlier_stats[
  exclude_outlier == FALSE
]

roc_plot_counts_filtered[
  ,
  c(
    "group_mean",
    "group_sd",
    "z_score",
    "shapiro_W",
    "shapiro_p",
    "shapiro_failed",
    "exclude_outlier"
  ) := NULL
]
```

```{r paired randomization tests}
test_input <- dcast(
  roc_plot_counts_with_outlier_stats,
  Difficulty + sample + Type + Count_Type ~ Method,
  value.var = "Count"
)

set.seed(0)

n_perm <- 500000

paired_randomization_test <- function(linear, surjected, n_perm = 10000) {
  keep <- !is.na(linear) & !is.na(surjected)

  linear <- linear[keep]
  surjected <- surjected[keep]

  paired_diff <- surjected - linear

  if (length(paired_diff) == 0) {
    return(data.table(
      n_pairs = 0,
      mean_linear = NA_real_,
      mean_surjected = NA_real_,
      mean_difference = NA_real_,
      median_difference = NA_real_,
      p_value = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  observed_mean_diff <- mean(paired_diff)

  perm_mean_diff <- replicate(
    n_perm,
    mean(paired_diff * sample(c(-1, 1), length(paired_diff), replace = TRUE))
  )

  p_value <- (
    sum(abs(perm_mean_diff) >= abs(observed_mean_diff)) + 1
  ) / (n_perm + 1)

  data.table(
    n_pairs = length(paired_diff),
    mean_linear = mean(linear),
    mean_surjected = mean(surjected),
    mean_difference = observed_mean_diff,
    median_difference = median(paired_diff),
    p_value = p_value
  )
}

randomization_results <- test_input[
  ,
  paired_randomization_test(
    linear = linear,
    surjected = surjected,
    n_perm = n_perm
  ),
  by = .(Difficulty, Type, Count_Type)
]

randomization_results[, p_adj_bonferroni := p.adjust(p_value, method = "bonferroni")]

randomization_results[
  order(Count_Type, Type, Difficulty)
]

fwrite(
  randomization_results,
  "randomization_test_results.tsv",
  sep = "\t"
)
```
